name: jsPDF
description_en: Client-side JavaScript PDF generation for everyone.
readme_excerpt: A library to generate PDFs in JavaScript. You can catch me on twitter: @MrRio or head over to my company's website for consultancy. jsPDF is now co-maintained by yWorks - the diagramming experts. Live Demo | Documentation Install Recommended: get jsPDF from npm: Or always get latest version via unpkg The dist folder of this package contains different kinds of files: - jspdf.es.\.js: Modern ES2015 module format. - jspdf.node.\.js: For running in Node.
